title: Fix PDF generation errors for all three products

requirements.text: Make PDF and ZIP generation robust by removing reliance on CDN-provided global variables and ensuring jsPDF and JSZip are available in production builds.

quotes: I got the same errors again for all 3 products. Please fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Generating a single product succeeds without requiring jsPDF/JSZip to exist on `window`.
Generating all 3 products succeeds in production and routes the user to the Export screen with 3 generated bundles.
No runtime error occurs due to `window.jspdf` or `window.JSZip` being undefined.

requirements.text: Improve error reporting during generation so the UI shows the actual root-cause message (in English) for failures, including whether the failure occurred during cover fetch, PDF generation, or ZIP generation, and for which product.

quotes: I got the same errors again for all 3 products. Please fix it

acceptanceCriteria: If generation fails, the editor screen shows an error message that includes the failing step (cover/PDF/ZIP) and the product number or product name.
Console logs include the original error object/stack for troubleshooting.
User-facing error text remains clear and English-only (no raw stack traces shown to users in production).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (no backend changes required for this fix unless strictly necessary).
nonGoals: Adding new product types or changing the product content/model.
Adding external services or new authentication providers.
